errors.name: NegativeStockError
errors.description: Raised when a wine's stock quantity is attempted to be set to or below zero.

errors.name: InvalidPricingException
errors.description: Raised when a wine's selling price is not strictly greater than its cost price.

errors.name: DuplicateWineNameError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to add a wine with a name that already exists in the system.

errors.name: LocationOverCapacityException
errors.description: Raised when attempting to assign a wine bottle to a storage location that is already at or exceeds its maximum bottle capacity.

errors.name: WineNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to access a wine that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: StorageLocationNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to access a storage location that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: InvalidWineTypeError
errors.description: Raised when an invalid wine type (not red, white, rosé, or sparkling) is provided.

errors.name: NegativeCapacityError
errors.description: Raised when a storage location's capacity is set to or below zero.
